assumptions: steady laminar fully developed Newtonian incompressible flow

notes: Base 8.04248 mW and 28.5508 mW match my pass 1 (8.042e-3 W, 2.855e-2 W). The outlet pressure cancels from the drop as claimed (C), agreeing with pass 1.
